recovery_disclosure: The original dedicated test API process was terminated after the actual shielded payment broadcast. Its temporary in-memory encryption key was lost. The pending order was restored into the main local application database from the retained authoritative API-generated order ID, memo and amount plus the known merchant address. No third payment was sent. The real running HTTP API then independently verified the existing mined payment and issued/redeemed the single-use entitlement. This is a recovered flow, not an uninterrupted end-to-end run.
flow: Live HTTP API verified existing payment
limits: The trusted receiving wallet verifies shielded amount and memo; public explorer verifies existence. Bitrefill settlement is separate and was not executed.
